card.name: "With" before a test or imaging method
card.fires_on: The word "with" right after "confirm the diagnosis" or "consider monitoring", where a test or imaging method comes next. Seen in label warnings about adrenal insufficiency and NSAID use in pregnancy.

modes.label: Confirm diagnosis with testing
modes.description: "with" after "confirm the diagnosis" in the adrenal insufficiency warning.
modes.example: If adrenal insufficiency is suspected, confirm the diagnosis<< with>> diagnostic testing as soon as possible.

modes.label: Monitoring with ultrasound
modes.description: "with" after "consider monitoring" in the NSAID warning about low amniotic fluid.
modes.example: If Etodolac Tablets treatment extends beyond 48 hours, consider monitoring<< with>> ultrasounds for oligohydram

card.plain: It marks the little word "with" that introduces which test or scan to use after a diagnosis or monitoring instruction.
